SessionStart.description: Opt-in baseline: when the project is activated (acv.config.json present), ensures .acv/ is gitignored, then writes an HMAC-signed snapshot of git-tracked files to .acv/session-start.json. Inert (writes nothing) when not activated.

PreToolUse.description: Denies writes to test files (per settings.test_path_allowlist) unless the caller is the test-author subagent. Emits hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision = 'deny'.

PostToolUse.description: [PLACEHOLDER — not yet implemented, Phase 3] Will run scoped pyright/tsc + ruff/eslint + an AST reward-hacking watchdog on production writes and emit decision:block on SUSPICIOUS. Currently a no-op.

Stop.description: [PLACEHOLDER — not yet implemented, Phase 3] Will invoke the Auditor in a clean sandbox and emit decision:block when the verification receipt is missing or the Verification-Quality Score is below the configured floor. Currently a no-op.

SubagentStop.description: [PLACEHOLDER — not yet implemented, Phase 3] Will re-run the Auditor against the stopped subagent's outputs and block on a success claim with no valid receipt. Currently a no-op.

PreCompact.description: [PLACEHOLDER — not yet implemented, Phase 3] Will refuse compaction while unresolved FAIL or SUSPICIOUS audit verdicts exist in the session. Currently a no-op.
